title: The WebSphere Application Server security auditing must be enabled.
check_content:
In the administrative console, navigate to Security >> Security auditing.

If "Enable security auditing" is not enabled, this is a finding.
fixtext:
In the administrative console, navigate to Security >> Security auditing to enable.

Restart the DMGR and all the JVMs.
VulnDiscussion:
Security auditing will not be performed unless the audit security subsystem has been enabled. Global security must be enabled for the security audit subsystem to function, as no security auditing occurs if global security is not also enabled. Enable global security before enabling security auditing.

Satisfies: SRG-APP-000016-AS-000013, SRG-APP-000343-AS-000030, SRG-APP-000080-AS-000045, SRG-APP-000092-AS-000053, SRG-APP-000266-AS-000168, SRG-APP-000267-AS-000170
